Both primary sources (Apple Newsroom + SEC EDGAR) agree; the "filings-online" mirror showing $361.2B/$79.4B/$5.12 is inconsistent with the actual 10-K and I'll disregard it.

**Assessment:** Apple's FQ4 (ended 9/28/2024) revenue was $94.9B, +6% YoY — the first return to growth in a year. FY2024 net sales $391.0B, net income $93.7B, diluted EPS $6.08 (held down by a one-time $10.2B EU tax charge), operating income $123.2B. With the stock around $222.70, that's ~36x trailing EPS and ~21x sales — rich but supported by buybacks, services mix, and the Apple Intelligence/iPhone 16 cycle. Price action is steady, no negative catalyst found. I'll take a partial position within the $10,000 per-order cap.
